title: So disappointing. $23/mo OVERpriced
text: I am shocked that anyone keeps the subscription past the first month. I signed up during prime day so I think I paid half price and what I received was worth less than five dollars. I received a whisk that you can buy at a dollar tree and recipe cards. That’s it. I purchased this for my 11-year-old daughter hoping to spur her interest in cooking. Even she was disappointed by this. Save your money. Go to the dollar tree and buy a whisk and find recipes online and you saved yourself $24
label: negative
